description: This file defines the SessionManager class responsible for handling user session management, including login, logout, token refresh, and persistence using Keychain. It manages authentication state and access tokens for secure API interactions.

classes.name: SessionManager
classes.description: A class managing user authentication sessions, including token storage, refresh, and validation.

methods.name: restoreFromKeychainIfPossible
methods.description: Restores session tokens from Keychain and attempts to refresh if tokens are expired.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Performs login with email and password, then persists tokens.

methods.name: authorizedRequestToken
methods.description: Returns a valid access token, refreshing it if necessary.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user, invalidates session, and clears stored tokens.

methods.name: refreshIfNeeded
methods.description: Refreshes access token if expired or about to expire.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies new tokens to the session state.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears session tokens from Keychain and memory.
